title: SPEAK LIFE
hookText: Your words are deciding how long you live
openLoop: Coming up: the affirmation that rewrites your life

teasers.text: Still ahead: why your words outlive you by 10 years
Still ahead: speak like the conqueror, not the grasshopper

recap.title: Speak Life
items: Death and life are in the power of your tongue
You are made in God's image — your words create
Every decision follows the words you accept
You will eat the fruit of the words you plant
So speak life: health, faith, and long life

scenes.point: Every decision you've ever made began with words you heard
The words you replay become the life you live
Everything you are today grew from yesterday's words
Speak life over yourself — out loud, on purpose
